notes.title: Funtasia is here!
notes.content:
Hey drivers! On your marks… Get set… GO!

Get ready to drive – Funtasia is now live! 🎉

[previewyoutube=Tf_r4fqLtwY;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your support throughout development! We could not have done it without you and your support. Our community means the absolute world to us and we’re so excited to share the finished product!

Be sure to let us know what you think! You can leave us a review, tell us about a bug you’ve found, or just to give some feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/YEGhKmk]Discord [/url]- we’d love to hear from you! You can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/fantasticodev]Twitter [/url]for more news.

notes.title: Almost to the Finish Line!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

In an effort to bring you the best game possible, we are unfortunately going to have to delay the launch date for Funtasia just a little bit. We are needing a couple more weeks to finish up our QA testing to ensure that you all are getting a game as bug-free as possible! We appreciate your patience and understanding. 

[h3]Our new launch date is September 29, 2022![/h3]

Thank you all for your support as we work towards our launch! We appreciate all of your patience as we make this announcement. As you await your chance to hit the tracks in Funtasia, feel free to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/YEGhKmk]Discord [/url]or on [url=https://twitter.com/fantasticodev]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement 🥳
notes.content:
Hey drivers! Breaks are for cowards - are you ready to race with us?

[b]Get ready to drive – Funtasia launches on September 15th, 2022 on PC and Switch! 🎉[/b]

[previewyoutube=-0ZtIVWzSmc;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your support throughout development! We’re super excited to show you everything we’ve accomplished - we hope you’re just as excited to see it as we are to show you.

You can show us your excitement by joining our community on [url=https://discord.gg/YEGhKmk]Discord [/url]or following us on [url=https://twitter.com/fantasticodev]Twitter [/url]while you wait for launch!

notes.title: We have a publisher!
notes.content:
Hey folks! 
We are very excited to announce today that we have officially signed with Freedom Games ( https://www.freedom.gg/ ) as our publisher! 

For those of you who may not know, a game publisher helps take care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store page, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. It really lets us totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be, and provides us with the resources to do so. 

Lots of exciting things are to come from this. We look forward to all of it and hope you do too! While you’re here, don’t forget to wishlist Funtasia - Furry Road here on Steam. If you want to join the community, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/fantasticodev]Twitter[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.gg/qwKnHTC6es]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
Hey folks,
the Funtasia public demo is finally available to everyone!

[previewyoutube=pIzZO61jTJ0;full][/previewyoutube]

You can play 2 different game modes:
[list]
[*] Story, defeat the monsters that filled Funtasia with garbage.
[*] Local Multiplayer, challenge your friends in 3 competitive or cooperative mini-games.
[/list]
The demo will only feature 2 of the 10 kingdoms of Funtasia. 
Online multiplayer game mode will be available in the early access version.

The development of Funtasia is still ongoing, so don’t forget to give us some feedback to improve the game before the release in Early Access.

We hope that you like our demo.
